title: GM is building its own in-vehicle AI assistant because Google’s Gemini cannot access what the car knows

content_html:
TL;DR

GM will launch a proprietary AI assistant later this year that goes beyond Gemini by integrating with OnStar, vehicle telemetry, and predictive maintenance. Unnamed LLM provider. Gemini stays.

General Motors will launch its own in-vehicle AI assistant later this year, built to access vehicle data that Google’s Gemini cannot reach. The system will integrate with OnStar, GM’s telemetry systems, and proprietary vehicle knowledge to offer predictive maintenance, real-time diagnostics, and auto-specific commands that a general-purpose assistant cannot provide. GM is working with an unnamed large language model provider on the technology.

“There’s a limit to what an AI that’s just sort of sitting at the top level of the vehicle can do,” said Anna Santos, GM’s director of product management for voice and AI. Gemini launched in eligible 2022 and newer GM vehicles earlier this year and handles conversational queries, temperature, and radio controls. The new GM assistant goes deeper: it will understand the vehicle’s mechanical state, driving patterns, and owner preferences. Santos described a “kids setting” command that would adjust music, seats, climate, and door locks simultaneously.

The distinction matters commercially. Gemini operates like a phone assistant projected onto the dashboard. GM’s proprietary system uses data that belongs to GM, not Google. “It’s data that’s going to be proprietary to GM,” Santos said. Google has been embedding AI across every product it controls, and GM’s decision to build a parallel system rather than hand all vehicle intelligence to Gemini reflects the same concern Nadella raised about companies outsourcing their thinking to a single AI provider.

GM is not replacing Gemini. Both assistants will coexist. The Gemini layer handles general queries and entertainment. The GM layer handles everything the car knows about itself. GM is also pushing its autonomous driving capabilities toward robotaxi-readiness, and an in-vehicle AI that understands predictive maintenance and telemetry feeds directly into fleet management for autonomous operations. Santos called it “the beginning of a broader AI journey.” The unnamed LLM provider suggests GM is keeping its options open on which model powers the system, avoiding the single-vendor dependency that its Gemini partnership already created.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

通用汽车将于今年晚些时候推出专有的人工智能助手，该助手将超越 Gemini，与 OnStar、车辆遥测和预测性维护相集成。 未透露姓名的法学硕士提供者。 双子座留下来。

通用汽车将于今年晚些时候推出自己的车载人工智能助手，旨在访问谷歌 Gemini 无法访问的车辆数据。 该系统将与 OnStar、通用汽车的遥测系统和专有车辆知识集成，以提供通用助手无法提供的预测性维护、实时诊断和汽车特定命令。 通用汽车正在与一家未透露姓名的大型语言模型提供商合作开发该技术。

通用汽车语音和人工智能产品管理总监安娜·桑托斯 (Anna Santos) 表示：“仅仅位于车辆顶层的人工智能能做的事情是有限的。” Gemini 在今年早些时候在符合条件的 2022 款和较新的通用汽车汽车中推出，可处理对话查询、温度和无线电控制。 新的通用汽车助手更深入：它将了解车辆的机械状态、驾驶模式和车主偏好。 桑托斯描述了一个“儿童设置”命令，可以同时调整音乐、座椅、气候和门锁。

这种区别在商业上很重要。 Gemini 的操作就像投射到仪表板上的电话助手。 通用汽车的专有系统使用属于通用汽车而非谷歌的数据。 “这些数据将归通用汽车所有，”桑托斯说。 谷歌一直在将人工智能嵌入到其控制的每一款产品中，而通用汽车决定建立一个并行系统，而不是将所有车辆智能交给 Gemini，这也反映了纳德拉对公司将思维外包给单一人工智能提供商的同样担忧。

通用汽车不会取代双子座。 两名助手将共存。 Gemini 层处理一般查询和娱乐。 通用汽车层处理汽车所知道的一切。 通用汽车还正在将其自动驾驶能力推向机器人出租车准备，并且了解预测性维护和遥测的车载人工智能直接输入到车队管理中以实现自动操作。 桑托斯称之为“更广泛的人工智能之旅的开始”。 这位不愿透露姓名的法学硕士提供商表示，通用汽车在选择哪种模型为系统提供动力方面保持开放，避免其与 Gemini 合作伙伴关系已经造成的单一供应商依赖。
